div.div: ALT: NO SIGNAL / CELLULAR OUTAGE - STORE-AND-FORWARD DRAIN UP TO 24 HOURS (ASM-074, A10 SEC 4.3)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 930px; margin-left: 48px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #7b341e;

div.div:
• Signal loss: Reading retained in encrypted non-volatile RAM (max 24 h). Evicted readings counted and reported in telemetry_gap event.
• Reconnection: Live reading published first, then buffered records drain oldest first. Evaluated at original_timestamp.
• Delayed flag: Readings with (arrival_time - original_timestamp) > 300 s marked delayed = true. Deduplication guarantees 1 alert per drain.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 724px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2670px; margin-left: 25px;

div.div:
Latency Budget per Hop (Connectivity sec 8.2, ASM-075):
Runs from original reading timestamp to receipt on farmer phone.
• Hop 1 (10 s): Reading taken to message ready. Zero threshold logic on node.
• Hop 2 (60 s): Radio wake, network attach, TLS setup (cellular or satellite).
• Hop 3 (20 s): MQTT publish QoS 1 to PUBACK at IoT Core in us-east-1.
• Hop 4 (10 s): Topic rule execution: telemetry table write + SQS enqueue.
• Hop 5 (20 s): Threshold Lambda: consistent read, evaluate rules, deduplicate.
• Hop 6 (30 s): Dispatcher Lambda: resolve PII (KMS 'personal'), SMS coalescing.
• Hop 7 (60 s): Provider to phone: parallel dispatch via SMS & Push (FCM/APNs).
Totals: Target = 210 s (3.5 min) | Margin = 90 s (1.5 min) | Limit = 300 s (5 min).
Tie to Point 6 Alert-Delivery SLO (A21, PD-082, PD-134):
• Live Alert SLI: Share of out-of-range live readings delivered within 300 s.
• Trace points: reading_ts, puback_ts, lambda_start, alert_persisted, delivery_ts.
• Offline Buffer Drain SLI: Drained readings delivered within 24 hours of capture.

div.div: 2. FEDERATION THRESHOLDS (CONFIGURABLE DATA, NEVER IN CODE)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 734px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2670px; margin-left: 800px;

div.div:
Initial Ranges Table from Case Statement (Sec 4.1):
• T-01 [Crop]: pH outside 4.5 - 6.0 (Recommended 4.9 - 5.6) | Soil analysis (ASM-053).
• T-02 [Crop]: Air moisture outside 40 % - 80 % relative humidity | Crop node.
• T-03 [Crop]: Soil moisture outside 40 % - 80 % | Crop node (ASM-131).
• T-04 [Crop]: Air temp outside 14 - 30 °C (Recommended 17 - 23 °C) | Crop node.
• T-05 [Crop]: Soil temp outside 14 - 30 °C (Recommended 17 - 23 °C) | Crop node.
• T-06..T-08 [Crop]: NPK | Pending Federation publication (ASM-054). Stored without alerts.
• T-09 [Drying]: Coffee moisture closure near 12 % | Tolerance: 0 (ASM-133, ASM-059).
• T-10 [Drying]: Grain temperature alert above 40 °C | Drying node.
Configuration & Scope Model (Sec 4.2, ASM-138):
• Threshold store: DynamoDB 'thresholds' table (KMS 'records'). PK: rule_key, SK: effective_from.
• Scope resolution: Farm-specific rule overrides Pilot rule. NPK is pilot-wide.
• Historical immutability: Version in force at original_timestamp is evaluated.
• Zero cache: Strongly consistent query on every invocation; immediate updates.
• Audit trail: CloudTrail write events + DynamoDB Streams to S3 Object Lock archive (5 years).

div.div: 3. EPISODE MODEL, DEDUPLICATION & STORE-AND-FORWARD DRAIN

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 734px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2670px; margin-left: 1585px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #2d3748;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#2d3748, #b7bfce); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Why Deduplicate (Sec 6.1, ASM-135):
• Variables stay out of range for hours; prevents 24 messages per drain.
• Prevents drone pest case explosion under ADR-002: episode is the unit of alerting.
Episode State Machine (Sec 6.2, Alert Store, KMS 'records'):
• Open Episode: First out-of-range reading opens Episode via conditional put. Emits
notification and persists crop_alert_raised (triggers ADR-002 drone mode switch).
• Attach Reading: Subsequent out-of-range readings update counts & extremes (0 alerts).
• Close Episode: First in-range reading closes episode (alert_resolved via push).
• 24-Hour Reminder: Sent once per 24 hours if episode remains open (push only).
• Drying Lot Closure: Moisture <= 12% emits single drying_closure_notice per lot.
Store-and-Forward Drain Behavior (Sec 6.4, ASM-074):
• Buffer sizing: Encrypted ring buffer holds >= 24 h of readings (6 crop, 24 drying).
• Drainage order: Reconnect sends live reading first, then buffered drain oldest first.
• Delayed alert handling: Receive time > 300 s marked delayed = true. 1 alert per drain.

div.div: 4. WHAT THE FARMER SEES & ARCHITECTURAL TRACEABILITY

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 749px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2670px; margin-left: 2370px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #2d3748;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#2d3748, #b7bfce); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Multi-Channel Strategy (Closes PD-085, ASM-136):
• Dual channel: Push + SMS for openings & closure notices. Push only for reminders/resolutions.
• SMS: Delivers over cellular network without requiring data balance (LTE or later, A10 sec 11).
• Push: Enriches farmer app with full history and curves when phone has data coverage.
• SMS Coalescing: First SMS sent immediately; alerts within 10 min combined (ASM-135).
Farmer Perception & Sample SMS (Sec 8, Colombia Time America/Bogota):
• Live SMS: 'Aroma Pacifico: farm El Mirador, soil moisture 34 % (range 40-80 %), measured 14:02. Check the app.'
• Delayed SMS: 'Aroma Pacifico: farm El Mirador, drying grain 43 C (limit 40 C), measured 23:10, received 06:15.'
• Closure SMS: 'Aroma Pacifico: farm El Mirador, drying lot at 12 % moisture. The lot can be closed.'
• Resolution Push: 'Soil moisture back in range (52 %) at 18:02.' | Zero PII, cedulas, coordinates, or links.
• Farmer App: Status Card (alert highlighted), Alerts List, History Charts (recommended bands).
IaC Traceability (Architecture sec 14, Track B):
• Box D08: Reusable Farm Module (field node, sensors, 24h buffer, X.509 cert) -> B08.
• Box D09: Telemetry Ingestion Pattern (IoT Core, topic rules, DynamoDB telemetry, SQS) -> B09.
• Box D10: Event-Driven Inference Pattern (Threshold queue, Lambda rules, Alert Store, SNS) -> B10.
• Box D06: Identity & KMS Encryption Keys ('telemetry', 'records', 'personal') -> B06.
